text:
maya: Heads up — we have a small follow-up for the py/ts SDK release window tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Need to coordinate deprecation annex, signer rotation, and a quick republish path if package signing fails.

sam: Thanks — what exactly is the risk with signer rotation?

maya: Our new KMS rotation will change artifact signatures for the final wheels and npm packages. If npm/twine rejects the upload, we need a documented fallback to republish under a temporary tag and then do a pin flip.

jin: Suggestion: attempt normal publish -> if signature mismatch, publish to @staging/temprelease and open a follow-up canary for 1hr. Then ops will flip traffic.

lex: Sounds fine. How will we communicate to customers who depend on exact versions? We should prepare deprecation annex notes and a short migration snippet.

maya: Draft annex is ready in the release PR: https://git.redwood/release/sdk-release/pull/487 — includes migration snippet and the exact deprecation window text. Need review + :rocket: approval by 08:00 UTC.

devex-release-bot: deploy-bot: Release window scheduled by maya for 2026-03-21 09:00 UTC. Channels: #devex, #eng-releases. Notified watchers.

sam: I'm going to run the preflight checks at 07:30 UTC. Checklist: unit tests, integration smoke, checksum verify, signing dry-run, docs build. Anyone wants to add?

jin: Add: local pip install test of wheel in a clean venv and npm install of the tarball in node:18 container. Also verify the license header script run.

lex: I'll prep the deprecation annex blurb and short migration snippet for both Python and TS. Put it in the PR under docs/annex-deprecation.md.

maya: For rollback decision tree: if publish fails due to signature but artifacts exist on registry in bad state, do not delete. Instead: 1) publish temp tag, 2) post note in release thread, 3) cut fixed release with patched signer and push final tag, 4) follow-up post that pins older tag if needed. If package is corrupted, escalate to infra and we may yank the artifact.

sam: Add a quick script for republish:```bash
# republish fallback
npm pack ./dist/my-sdk.tgz && npm publish --tag temprelease
python -m pip upload --sign --repository-url https://upload.pypi.org/legacy/ dist/* --comment "temp publish"
```

jin: We'll need credentials access window. Ops: request temporary PyPI creds and npm automation token with publish scope for 06:30-12:00 UTC.

maya: Ops confirmed with Security — ephemeral token will be generated by the release keyholder (lex). Lex, can you generate and add to vault with a 6hr TTL?

lex: Yes. I'll create and add to vault by 06:00 UTC. Will post vault link in this thread when ready.

devex-release-bot: deploy-bot: Preflight run started by sam at 2026-03-21 07:30:12 UTC. Status: running checks.

sam: Preflight green except one lint failure in typings. Fixing now, should be done in 10m.

maya: After release, we should run the quality eval harness against prod model responses for the SDK-generated prompts. Add rollback threshold: if eval error rate > 8% on critical prompt set, trigger rollback.

jin: Agreed. I'll wire the eval job and the alert. If triggered, the release owner will initiate rollback steps within 30m.

lex: Drafted annex and migration blurb pushed. PR link updated. :white_check_mark:

maya: Great. Final ask: everyone available for the first 2h after release for on-call. I'll be on until 12:30 UTC. Sam, Jin, Lex please monitor.

sam: Available.

jin: Available.

lex: Available.

devex-release-bot: deploy-bot: Preflight completed at 2026-03-21 07:42:05 UTC — all checks passed. Ready to start release at 09:00 UTC.

maya: Perfect. If anything deviates, post here with the phrase "RELEASE-ROLLBACK" so bots and watchers pick it up.

sam: Got it. See you all on the thread during the window.

maya: Thanks team. :v:
